sentences.en: The Tanach is full of flawed people repeatedly falling short.
sentences.zh: 《塔纳赫》充满了反复犯错的人。

sentences.en: Though I refused repeatedly, he insisted that I should go there.
sentences.zh: 尽管我再三拒绝，他还是坚持让我去那里。

sentences.en: In his autobiography, he repeatedly refers to his unhappy school days.
sentences.zh: 在他的自传中，他多次提到不快乐的学校时光。
